summary: Sandbach United's opening day of the season didn't go to plan, falling to a 3-2 defeat at Foley Meir despite creating plenty of chances and scoring a fine Saul Shotton volley. The Bach will be looking to bounce back this Saturday at home against promotion-challenging Stafford Town, and will need to tighten up defensively after giving away soft free kicks and struggling to mark set pieces in their first outing.
